g.text: Divide creates tile and rest coordinates
zipped_divide(L,T) views the original larger layout as a new two-mode layout: (within tile, which repeated tile).
L starts undivided. The tiler describes one tile; zipped_divide creates tile/rest coordinate modes.
Only now does the view have two grouped coordinate parts.
rest mode gives each tile's starting offset;
within-tile mode gives the offset inside that tile;
element offset in this layout = tile_start + within_tile_offset
How to read the divided coordinate
Two common slices of the divided view
use: distribute complete tiles across CTAs
result: that element position across all tiles
use: distribute those positions to CTA threads
